title: tetraberlinia bifoliolata
intro: Tetraberlinia bifoliolata, commonly known as African rosewood, is a plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae. The plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and fever, and its antimicrobial properties help in the treatment of various infections. Its therapeutic actions include antioxidant, anti-diarrheal, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Tetraberlinia bifoliolata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
